title: Execute workflow-backed worker in isolated workspace
description:
As an operator, I want Kanbus to run a worker from a repo-owned workflow, so that a target repository can be changed safely in an isolated branch.

Feature: Workflow-backed worker execution
Scenario: Run a Call Criteria trial worker
Given a workflow file and a synthetic safe task
When the orchestrator dispatches one worker
Then the worker creates an isolated workspace from develop, runs Codex App Server, validates with make test, pushes a trial branch, and does not open a PR.
